name: section
definition: primary for the pre-registered block, exploratory for everything else.

name: test_id
definition: Stable identifier of the figure.

name: label
definition: Plain-English description of the figure.

name: scope
definition: all pairs, or pair when the row is for one trading pair.

name: pair
definition: The trading pair when scope is pair; blank otherwise.

name: horizon_bars
definition: Forecast horizon in hourly bars, where it applies.

name: metric
definition: What the value measures.

name: n
definition: Number of origins (or calls) behind the figure, where it applies.

name: value
definition: The figure, at full precision as stored in results.json; blank where not applicable.

name: ci_low
definition: Lower end of the interval, full precision; blank where not applicable.

name: ci_high
definition: Upper end of the interval, full precision; blank where not applicable.

name: p_raw
definition: Raw p-value of the exact test, full precision; blank where not applicable.

name: p_holm
definition: Holm-adjusted p-value, full precision; blank where not applicable.

name: decision
definition: The pre-registered decision text, unchanged; blank where not applicable.

name: status
definition: primary or exploratory. Every row outside the primary block is exploratory.

name: display
definition: A human-readable string, rounded once for display. Use value, ci_low, ci_high, p_raw and p_holm for analysis.

name: source_key
definition: Where each column came from inside results.json, as name=key.path pairs separated by semicolons; [i] indexes a list.

name: kronos_accuracy
definition: Kronos accuracy at 24 bars, all pairs; day-block bootstrap interval. **Analysis set N:** origins with status ok, label_24 != 0 and signal_24 != 0. | **Bootstrap:** B = 10,000 resamples of forecast days with replacement from the days present in the analysis set. For each drawn day all pairs' origins in the analysis set are taken. numpy `default_rng` seed 20261106. Percentile 95% confidence intervals for (a) Kronos accuracy and (b) Kronos accuracy minus always-up accuracy.

name: kronos_accuracy_naive_interval
definition: Kronos accuracy at 24 bars, naive binomial interval (ignores clustering). **Bootstrap:** B = 10,000 resamples of forecast days with replacement from the days present in the analysis set. For each drawn day all pairs' origins in the analysis set are taken. numpy `default_rng` seed 20261106. Percentile 95% confidence intervals for (a) Kronos accuracy and (b) Kronos accuracy minus always-up accuracy. The naive interval treats origins as independent: "The exact tests treat origins as independent."

name: kronos_correct_calls
definition: Number of correct Kronos calls at 24 bars. `m_h` is the mean over the 11 samples of the predicted close of bar h. `signal_h = sign(m_h - last_close)`; signal 0 is excluded. | Forecast bar h opens at (h-1):00 UTC of the forecast day. For h in {1, 4, 24}: `actual_h` is the real close of bar h; `label_h = sign(actual_h - last_close)`. Label 0 is excluded for that h and the count is reported.

name: forecast_days
definition: Number of forecast days in the analysis set. **Bootstrap:** B = 10,000 resamples of forecast days with replacement from the days present in the analysis set. For each drawn day all pairs' origins in the analysis set are taken. numpy `default_rng` seed 20261106. Percentile 95% confidence intervals for (a) Kronos accuracy and (b) Kronos accuracy minus always-up accuracy.

name: always_up_accuracy
definition: Always-up accuracy at 24 bars (share of analysis-set origins whose label is up). **H2:** always-up predicts up everywhere. Exact two-sided McNemar test on the discordant pairs. The two discordant counts are reported, together with the number of Kronos down-calls. Discordance can only occur where Kronos calls down: Kronos-right-and-always-up-wrong when signal and label are both down, and Kronos-wrong-and-always-up-right when the signal is down and the label is up.

name: accuracy_difference
definition: Kronos accuracy minus always-up accuracy; day-block bootstrap interval. **Bootstrap:** B = 10,000 resamples of forecast days with replacement from the days present in the analysis set. For each drawn day all pairs' origins in the analysis set are taken. numpy `default_rng` seed 20261106. Percentile 95% confidence intervals for (a) Kronos accuracy and (b) Kronos accuracy minus always-up accuracy.

name: H1_vs_coin_flip
definition: H1: Kronos accuracy against a coin flip (exact two-sided binomial test). **H1:** exact two-sided binomial test of the number of correct signals against 0.5. | **Multiplicity:** Holm correction across H1 and H2 at family alpha 0.05.

name: H1_largest_edge_not_ruled_out
definition: H1: largest edge over a coin flip not ruled out (upper end of the interval). **Decision rule:**

name: H2_vs_always_up
definition: H2: Kronos against always-up (exact two-sided McNemar test). **H2:** always-up predicts up everywhere. Exact two-sided McNemar test on the discordant pairs. The two discordant counts are reported, together with the number of Kronos down-calls. Discordance can only occur where Kronos calls down: Kronos-right-and-always-up-wrong when signal and label are both down, and Kronos-wrong-and-always-up-right when the signal is down and the label is up. | **Multiplicity:** Holm correction across H1 and H2 at family alpha 0.05.

name: H2_largest_gain_not_ruled_out
definition: H2: largest gain over always-up not ruled out (upper end of the interval). **Decision rule:**
